sisi.depan: At the far end, a grand tiered joglo hall with massive carved teakwood doors is flanked by holographic projectors displaying abstract geometric batik patterns and illuminated by glowing candi-stone lanterns.
sisi.kanan: To the right, an open-air pavilion with a tiered roof features an elevated training platform with a glowing force-field perimeter, while a wide stone staircase leads up to a second-story balcony with white-and-teal paneling.
sisi.belakang: Behind the viewpoint, the courtyard is entered through a massive candi-style gate flanked by two smaller, tiered-roof guard posts.
sisi.kiri: On the left, a long academy wing has a wide archway leading to the library gardens, its walls inset with floor-to-ceiling smart-glass windows that shift in opacity, and a distant view of a waterfall cascading down the mountainside.

tengah: In the center of the stone-paved courtyard sits a large, circular reflecting pool with a single, intricately carved stone monolith at its heart from which a low hum emanates.
atas: Overhead, the faint, shimmering gold lattice of a planetary energy shield is visible against the clear mountain sky, with the tiered joglo rooftops of the surrounding halls trimmed in gold jutting into view.
